events.name: New York Jets at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: Ronnie Stanley was on the field during the portion of practice open to reporters.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens getting healthier as opener approaches

events.name: New England Patriots at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw a pair of touchdown passes to move within one of the NFL career record, Stephon Gilmore returned one of his two interceptions 64 yards for a score, and the New England Patriots clinched a playoff berth Sunday with a 34-13 victory over...
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws 2 TDs, Patriots beat Bengals to clinch playoffs

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Jameis Winston became the first player in NFL history to throw for 450 yards in consecutive games, leading the Tampa Bay Buccaneers to a 38-17 win over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston throws 4 TDs, helps Buccaneers beat Lions 38-17

events.name: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Jones ran for two scores, Davante Adams caught another and the Green Bay Packers defeated the Chicago Bears 21-13 on Sunday in the 200th edition of he NFL's oldest rivalry.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones scores twice, Packers complete season sweep of Bears

headlines.description: The Houston Texans grabbed control of the AFC South by beating the Tennessee Titans 24-21 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans take control of AFC South by beating Titans 24-21

events.name: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes threw for 340 yards and two touchdowns, Tyreek Hill and Travis Kelce were on the receiving end of many of his biggest throws, and the AFC West champion Kansas City Chiefs romped to a 23-3 victory over the Denver Broncos at snowy...
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs roll to 23-3 victory over Broncos at snowy Arrowhead

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New York Giants

headlines.description: Two-time Super Bowl MVP Eli Manning threw two touchdowns in what might have been his final home start for the Giants and New York snapped a franchise record-tying nine-game losing streak with a 36-20 victory over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning throws 2 TDs, Barkley scores 2, Giants end long skid
Wentz, Eagles keep NFC East hopes alive by beating Redskins

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw for 286 yards and two touchdowns, Chris Carson ran for 133 yards and two scores, and the Seattle Seahawks defeated the Carolina Panthers 30-24 on Sunday to inch closer to clinching a playoff spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson, Carson lift Seahawks past Panthers 30-24

headlines.description: Gardner Minshew threw two TD passes to Chris Conley in the final 5:15 of the game and the Jacksonville Jaguars spoiled the final scheduled game at the Oakland Coliseum by beating the Raiders 20-16 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars spoil final Oakland game with 20-16 win over Raiders

headlines.description: Kenyan Drake ran for four touchdowns, Kyler Murray threw for 219 yards and a score and the Arizona Cardinals snapped a six-game losing streak by beating the Cleveland Browns 38-24 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drake scores 4 TDs, Cardinals roll past Browns 38-24

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Los Angeles Chargers
Los Angeles Rams at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Dak Prescott made up for the gaffe that wasn't on the coin toss. The star quarterback of the Dallas Cowboys had some help from backfield mate Ezekiel Elliott.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys render coin toss mix-up moot, throttle Rams 44-21

headlines.description: Matt Ryan teamed up with Julio Jones on a 5-yard pass that was ruled a touchdown after a replay reversal with 2 seconds left, sending the Atlanta Falcons past the playoff-bound San Francisco 49ers 29-22 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matt Ryan, Falcons rally in final seconds, stun 49ers 29-22

headlines.description: Josh Allen threw a 14-yard touchdown pass to Tyler Kroft with 7:55 to play and the Buffalo Bills clinched a playoff spot, beating the Pittsburgh Steelers 17-10 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Allen's fourth-quarter TD clinches playoff spot for Bills

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees became the NFL's all-time leader in touchdown passes, throwing for four scores to lead the New Orleans Saints to a 34-7 victory over the Indianapolis Colts on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees sets NFL all-time TD mark as Saints crush Colts 34-7
